Before removing and refitting the Air Bag module the following preliminary operations must be carried out:- Turn the ignition key to the OFF position and extract it;- Disconnect the battery leads and insulate them. Wait for 10 minutes before continuing.

FOLLOW ALL THE RECOMMENDED SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS (see 5580C - Precautions).
